_comment: Master orchestrator configuration for the Secure Data Destruction System (SDDS). Tune timeouts here when a phase exceeds its limit. Chapter 45: Secure Infrastructure Decommissioning.

documentation_analysis.description: Parse infrastructure documentation and build destruction inventory

security_device_preparation.description: Export YubiHSM audit logs and prepare YubiKey revocation lists

authentication_isolation.description: Revoke all authentication credentials and SSO tokens

parallel_infrastructure_destruction.description: Simultaneously destroy AWS resources, storage, and compute (ThreadPoolExecutor)

network_destruction.description: Factory-reset Meraki networks and MikroTik RouterOS devices

verification.description: Verify all destruction completed; generate final audit report

self_destruct.description: Wipe the SEN500 orchestrator node itself (final phase)
